Stop the run unless the data holds: a row count, allowed values, unique, not empty or a range.

**Status:** Runs. In the palette under **Advanced operations > SQL and checks**.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Manipulation](../categories/manipulation.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | check, count, rows, expect, quality, allowed, unique, empty, range |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | The same table, when the check passes |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| check_name | `check_name` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Label shown when the check fails. |
| check | `check` | Choice | `row_count` | `row_count`, `allowed_values`, `unique`, `not_empty`, `range` | The run | What is checked. |
| expected_rows | `expected_rows` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Exact number of rows expected. |
| min_rows | `min_rows` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Fewest rows allowed. |
| max_rows | `max_rows` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Most rows allowed. |
| count_true_column | `count_true_column` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Count only rows where this boolean column is true. |
| count_column | `count_column` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Count only rows where this column equals count_value. |
| count_value | `count_value` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Value to match in count_column (compared as text) |
| column | `column` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | allowed_values, not_empty, range: the column checked. |
| columns | `columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | unique: the columns whose values must not repeat (comma list) |
| allowed | `allowed` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | allowed_values: the values allowed (comma list, compared as text) |
| min_value | `min_value` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | range: the smallest value allowed. |
| max_value | `max_value` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | range: the largest value allowed. |
| on_failure | `on_failure` | Choice | `stop` | `stop` | The run | What a failed check does. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
